text:
Ravi S.: Alert : duplicate prepaid invoice posted for North America customers. Looks like the billing adapter re-ingested the same file twice after an S3 retry. Net effect: recognized revenue overstated by 120,000 USD for Apr close.
BillingBot: [automated] import_notice: prepaid_na_20260430.csv processed (rows: 46); duplicate detection returned false due to missing file checksum header.
Dana L.: Materiality-wise 120k > 50k. We need an adjusting journal and full audit packet. Who has the list of affected customers/line items?
Olivia R.: I'm pulling the reconciliation now. Preliminary: 8 customers impacted, amounts range 5k-40k, total 120,000 USD. The duplicated rows were identical invoice ids but different import run ids.
Sophie W.: Eng found root cause: S3 transient error caused uploader to re-post with modified metadata; checksum header not preserved, so dedupe logic missed it. Hotfix ready to require invoice_id+checksum. Will deploy after we confirm finance package.
Ravi S.: Proposed adjusting JE (USD) to correct Apr recognized revenue and move to Deferred Revenue pending final disposition:
```
DR Recognized Revenue (4001)    120,000
CR Deferred Revenue (2100)      120,000
Memo: "Adjusting JE for duplicate prepaid invoice ingestion (prepaid_na_20260430.csv). Reverse when corrected import/credit applied."
```
Dana L.: Approve posting per policy given materiality. For audit packet we need: spreadsheet with invoice ids/customer ids/amounts, Billing import logs (both runs), vendor file, ticket, and ops remediation evidence (hotfix + regression test).
Olivia R.: I'll assemble the spreadsheet and attach diffs showing duplicate invoice ids and import run ids. ETA: 2 hours.
OpsBot: [automated] ticket_created: FIN-NA-296700 (duplicate prepaid ingestion 120k adjusting JE required)
Sophie W.: We'll deploy the dedupe fix to staging first and then prod after you've posted the JE and validated the spreadsheet. We'll also schedule a reprocess of the second import in dry-run mode and produce checksums and logs. ETA for reprocess: 6 hrs.
Ravi S.: Finance asks that ops include original file checksums, transformed file checksum, and the dry-run log. Also request the S3 object versions for both uploads for vendor tracing.
Dana L.: Also include currency handling note: all amounts USD; if any were billed in CAD we need fx entries. Olivia, flag those if present.
Olivia R.: Will do. I see one CAD line; I'll include FX conversion and explain treatment.
Ravi S.: Timeline: spreadsheet + ticket links by EOD PT, JE to post tomorrow morning after Dana sign-off, ops reprocess logs within 24 hrs, and remediation evidence in ticket.
Dana L.: Adding to month-end exceptions list. If vendor issues credit memos, we'll reverse the JE when credits apply; if not, we'll amortize per contract terms.
Ravi S.: Thanks everyone. tagging @finance-ops and @eng-billing for visibility :white_check_mark:
